title: GOOD Meat cultivated-chicken manufacturing dossier
scope: Public U.S. CCC000001 process through March2023 consultation plus June2023 labeling correction; Singapore serum-free announcement maintained as a separate process record.

processIdentity.biomass: Cultured cells with fibroblast characteristics, harvested as cell mass/paste

donor.origin: Embryonic torso tissue from10-day chicken embryos, used to establish parental line
donor.procurement: Commercial ATCC line; dossier reports two initial adherent passages before parental banking
donor.immortalization: Spontaneous selection; company says its C1F cells are not recombinant/engineered
donor.limits: false means this described source is embryonic, not a finding about all company cell lines.

stages.knownInputs: Appended historical ATCC sheet describes DMEM plus10% FBS, Trypsin-EDTA subculture and complete growth medium plus5% DMSO cryopreservation.
unknowns: Exact source lots and donor handling
Whether all supplier recommendations were actually followed
stages.locator: July8 amendment appended ATCC sheet p12/PDFp114; visually checked
stages.boundary: Historical supplier instructions are not GOOD Meat C1F-P1 banking or production recipes.

stages.stage: C1F adherent expansion and suspension adaptation
stages.knownInputs: Serum-supplemented medium; subsequently lower bovine serum and C1F-P1 naming.
C1F-P1 expansion in low-serum conditions, concentration and cryopreservation; documented batch and chain of custody.
stages.boundary: Do not import5% DMSO/10% FBS from the appended ATCC recommendation into this recipe.

stages.knownInputs: MCB aliquots thawed; medium dilution, centrifugation, resuspension, expansion, then cryopreservation; vials stored in vapor-phase liquid nitrogen.
unknowns: Full cryomedium recipe and component origins

stages.knownInputs: Qualified bank thaw; shake flasks, wave bag; basal amino acids, vitamins, salts and other components plus FBS.
unknowns: Amino acid, vitamin, growth factor and other component source provenance

stages.knownInputs: 200L then1000L vessels in the disclosed flow. Basal medium plus FBS. D-glucose may supplement; sodium hydroxide/hydrochloric acid may control pH. PluronicF68 anti-clumping agent documented.
unknowns: Exact FBS percentage and complete stage recipe

stages.knownInputs: For aggregates, sampled cells are centrifuged, resuspended in TrypLE and enzyme activity inactivated with serum-containing medium before counting.
stages.boundary: An analytical sample treatment; not established as a production-wide harvest input or returned-to-batch ingredient.

stages.knownInputs: Centrifugation,0.45%NaCl washes; second/final wash tested; cells stored at -20C or below according to FDA memo.
animalInputs: Residual BSA measured in harvested cells
unknowns: Full mass balance for every medium constituent

stages.knownInputs: Biomass shipped for later food manufacture. Process amendment describes intended products with60–75%w/w cultured chicken ingredient.
animalInputs: Cultured chicken biomass with its residuals
stages.boundary: Intended formulation range is not a verified marketed2026 product or evidence for GOOD Meat3.

publicNamedComponents.confidentialBasis: FDA memo p9 fn10 and p10; dossier p16

antibiotics.currentProcess: No antibiotic agents identified by firm for its cell culture process (FDA memo p9)
antibiotics.historicalLineDevelopment: Appended patent protocols contain antibiotics; not imported into current process
antibiotics.boundary: Current-process statement is not a claim that no antibiotic ever occurred in parental-line history.

animalMaterialControls.source: July8 response pp14–15/PDFpp116–117; FDA memo p5
animalMaterialControls.documented: Bovine source controls, disease screening, approved harvest facilities, filtration and heat inactivation are described.
animalMaterialControls.reason: Veterinary/food-safety source controls do not supply religious slaughter/certification provenance.

scaffold.basis: Described proliferation is suspension culture and harvest is biomass. No introduced scaffold is identified in reviewed flow; this is not proof of absence across all processes.

scaffoldsAndAids.foodContact: Single-use plastics and CIP/SIP stainless steel; company food-contact assertions; no material-origin/certifier audit conducted.

bsaHarvestedCellMaterial.rounding: Rounded displayed inputs average15.675; preserve reported15.67 rather than impose a new rounding rule.

bsaFinalWash.matrix: Wash liquid, not harvested cell biomass

pluronicHarvestedBiomass.result: Not detected; FDA discusses conservative upper-bound10mg/100g at assay detection limit

composition.boundary: Not nutritional equivalence per wet-weight serving; dry-normalized comparison and intended formulation share are distinct.
